```{python}
# | echo: false
query = f"""SELECT
		[controls].control_field
      ,SUM([control_value]) AS control_value
      ,SUM([result]) AS result
  FROM [PopulationSim_v1].[outputs].[control_totals]
  LEFT JOIN [PopulationSim_v1].[inputs].[controls]
  ON [control_totals].run_id = [controls].run_id AND [control_totals].control_id = [controls].control_id
  WHERE [control_totals].run_id = {run_id} AND [control_totals].geography NOT IN ('mgra', 'PUMA')
  GROUP BY [controls].control_field"""

region_control_fields = pd.read_sql_query(query, engine)
```

```{python}
# | echo: false
def clean_data(df, category_map):
    # Map control_field to General Category using the provided mapping
    df["General Category"] = df["control_field"].map(category_map)

    # Calculate Difference # and Difference % between control_value and result
    df["Difference #"] = df["control_value"] - df["result"]
    df["Difference %"] = round(
        (df["control_value"] - df["result"]) / df["result"] * 100, 2
    )

    # Sort the DataFrame by General Category
    df = df.sort_values("General Category")

    # Rename columns to have consistent capitalization and naming
    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            "control_field": "Control Field",
            "control_value": "Control",
            "result": "Result",
        }
    )

    return df
```

# Run ID - `{python} run_id`

Enclosed is a summary evaluating the alignment of our PopulationSim model's outputs with the inputted Controls for run ID #`{python} run_id`. This PopulationSim run draws data from the staging table `{python} run_info['staging_schema'].iloc[0]`. Run ID #`{python} run_id` houses outputs for the year `{python} run_info['year'].iloc[0]`. Further comments on this run include: `{python} run_info['comments'].iloc[0]`. SANDAG sets control parameters at both regional and MGRA levels. ```{python}
# | echo: false
def add_commas_to_dataframe(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Styler:
    """
    Applies thousands separator formatting to numeric columns in a pandas DataFrame,
    with different formats for integer and floating-point columns. Integer columns
    are formatted without decimal places ("{:,.0f}"), while floating-point columns
    display two decimal places ("{:,.2f}").

    Parameters:
    df (pd.DataFrame): The DataFrame to which comma formatting will be applied.

    Returns:
    Styler: A pandas Styler object with comma formatting applied to numeric columns.
    """

    format_dict = {}
    for col in df.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(df[col]):
            format_dict[col] = "{:,.0f}"  # Format for integer columns
        elif pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(df[col]):
            format_dict[col] = "{:,.2f}"  # Format for float columns

    return df.style.format(format_dict)

```

# | echo: false
def build_scatter_plot(df, y_axis, title, x_range=None, y_range=None):
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
    scatter = plt.scatter(df["Control"], df[y_axis], s=75)

    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel("Control")
    plt.ylabel(y_axis)

    # Adding a horizontal line at y=0
    plt.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=1, linestyle="dashed")

    # Update x-axis and y-axis with provided ranges
    if x_range is not None:
        plt.xlim(x_range)
    if y_range is not None:
        plt.ylim(y_range)

    plt.show()


```

```{python}
# | echo: false
def summary_statistics(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Compute summary statistics including median for 'Difference #' and 'Difference %'
    df1 = (
        df.groupby("Control Field")
        .agg(
            average_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                "mean",
            ),  # Average of 'Difference #'
            median_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                "median",
            ),  # Median of 'Difference #'
            average_difference_pct=(
                "Difference %",
                "mean",
            ),  # Average of 'Difference %'
            median_difference_pct=(
                "Difference %",
                "median",
            ),  # Median of 'Difference %'
            std_dev_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                "std",
            ),  # Standard Deviation of 'Difference #'
            max_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                lambda x: x.abs().max(),
            ),  # Max 'Difference #' in absolute value
            max_difference_pct=(
                "Difference %",
                lambda x: x.abs().max(),
            ),  # Max 'Difference %' in absolute value
        )
        .round(2)
        .reset_index()
    )

    df2 = (
        df.groupby("General Category")
        .agg(
            average_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                "mean",
            ),  # Average of 'Difference #'
            median_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                "median",
            ),  # Median of 'Difference #'
            average_difference_pct=(
                "Difference %",
                "mean",
            ),  # Average of 'Difference %'
            median_difference_pct=(
                "Difference %",
                "median",
            ),  # Median of 'Difference %'
            std_dev_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                "std",
            ),  # Standard Deviation of 'Difference #'
            max_difference_num=(
                "Difference #",
                lambda x: x.abs().max(),
            ),  # Max 'Difference #' in absolute value
            max_difference_pct=(
                "Difference %",
                lambda x: x.abs().max(),
            ),  # Max 'Difference %' in absolute value
        )
        .round(2)
        .reset_index()
    )

    # Assign "All" to generalize the category in df2
    df2["General Category"] = "All"
    # Ensure df2 columns match df1
    df2.columns = df1.columns

    # Concatenate df1 and df2
    df = pd.concat([df1, df2], ignore_index=True)
    # Rename columns to include medians
    df.columns = [
        "Control Field",
        "Avg Diff #",
        "Med Diff #",
        "Avg Diff %",
        "Med Diff %",
        "Diff STD #",
        "Max |Diff #|",
        "Max |Diff %|",
    ]

    return df

```

# | output: asis
# | echo: false
for x in mgra_control_fields["General Category"].unique():
    display(Markdown(f"### {x}"))
    mgra_control_fields["Difference %"] = mgra_control_fields["Difference %"].replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
    )
    tbl = mgra_control_fields[mgra_control_fields["General Category"] == x][
        [
            "mgra",
            "General Category",
            "Control Field",
            "Control",
            "Result",
            "Difference #",
            "Difference %",
        ]
    ]

    build_scatter_plot(
        df=tbl,
        y_axis="Difference #",
        title=f"{x} - Numeric Difference",
        x_range=(
            0,
            mgra_control_fields["Control"].max(),
        ),
        y_range=(
            mgra_control_fields["Difference #"].min(),
            mgra_control_fields["Difference #"].max(),
        ),
    )

    build_scatter_plot(
        df=tbl,
        y_axis="Difference %",
        title=f"{x} - Percent Difference",
        x_range=(
            0,
            mgra_control_fields["Control"].max(),
        ),
        y_range=(
            mgra_control_fields["Difference %"].min(),
            mgra_control_fields["Difference %"].max(),
        ),
    )
    summary_stats_table = summary_statistics(tbl)

    display(HTML(add_commas_to_dataframe(summary_stats_table).to_html(index=False)))

    print("")
